_metadata.selection: Latest saved full-size verified run per exact suite/name, ordered by source artifact modification time and record index. Reduced jq diagnostics and profiled A/B runs are excluded.
_metadata.methodology: Single saved measurements from correctness validation, with concurrent runs and mixed adapter revisions. Optional extra warmup disabled except the four microbenchmark kernels, which always warm once. These values are imported as recorded; they are not three-run medians or a matched performance comparison.
_metadata.warmup_metadata_correction: fast-followup.json records the parent default warmup of 1; its saved driver explicitly sets child NATIVE_BENCH_WARMUP=0. Effective warmup is recorded in each imported sample.
